lines: Dialogue during The Old Peace. Note: missing text transcripts are listed as: (?)
> “Albrecht Entrati's trail leads beyond the Origin System. Only by delving into the past can the path ahead be made clear - but buried secrets can be deadly.”
- Adis: "Mo hu-da, Ten-no. I win. You let?"
- Lotus: "This is the only way we find -"
- Loid: "Flooding their head with polluted histories? I won't - Come, Tenno. Let's get you dry."
- Operator: "It's okay, Loid. have to... I want to."
- Operator: "I had a friend, Loid. Like me. His name was... was... Adis."

- Ballas: "We swore to carry the sacred light of our dominion into the deepest dark, and this we have done! Swear now to defend this holy treaty alongside our blessed and brave creations: the Sentients of Tau."
- Operator: "Can you believe we used to be at war?"
- Operator: "It's just... insane. When all the time it could have been like this."
- Grineer Announcer: "Guve me someklung to shoot. Ron't det garr guigrr rorn." - "Give me something to shoot. Don't let your guard down."
- Grineer Announcer: "Tray sharg, Hu rear someklung." - "Stay sharp, I hear something."
- Grineer Announcer: "Guve me someklung to shoot." - "Give me something to shoot."
- Grineer Announcer: "Kekome an Exhumus. Ron't det garr guigrr rorn." - "Become an Eximus. Don't let your guard down."
- Adis: "What your parents say, if they here?"
- Operator: "Oh, they'd invite you to dinner, then panic over what to feed you."
- Operator: "Did they ever tell you what happened to your ancestors?"
- Adis: "Making up the great Rail, was the telling. First you serve as labor. Then you serve as parts."
- Operator: "I've been working on some new moves. Gonna let me try them out on you?"
- Adis: "First we find new fighting place! We get caught, Grineer think war-times come again!"
- Operator: "Anything you want to go over before Itzam grills you?"
- Adis: "Adis... maybe forgot Naramon principles section 8?"
- Operator: "Again? Okay, don't sweat it. I've got your back."
- Margulis: "I trust Itzam over the Orokin. Have him report to me daily."
- Daklo: "Disgusting, isn't it? Orokin gold - wasted! I wonder... which of you would this aberration attack first?"
- Archimedean Itzam: "Ah, please, please, with me. The place for conflict is in the dojo."
- Archimedean Itzam: "Adis Truth-Bloom, have you adapted to the Tenno Ways?"
- Archimedean Itzam: "When the applications of Tauron are applied to Naramon's theories, what is the expected outcome?"
- Adis: "Uh, a Somatic connection new, power increase many?"
- Archimedean Itzam: "No cheating! If you are tested by the Seven, we must show your evolution to their ways."
- Adis: "Cannot be done! You are tricking."
- Archimedean Itzam: "No cheating! Especially when the answer is grievously incorrect! Would you embarrass us so before the Seven?"
- Archimedean Itzam: "The treaty is not as finished as we would wish. The conditions laid upen our stewardship -"
- Apex Stentor: "Anarch strike is underway! Tauron students, to deployment!"
- Assignator Korffel: "Well, praise the Void. You two managed to show up on time. Boro Overlook. Go. Now."
- Valdur: "We're pinned down, Tenno. Can you give us a miracle?"
- The Man in the Wall: "That's the spirit, kiddo. Limb... from.. limb."
- Adis: "Cast and cry, cast and cry" ｜ "Raise the million pylons high" ｜ "All our kin are bound to fly" ｜ "For that far shore forlorn"
- Valdur: "That was the old Makvos cannon. Can you take it out?"
- Operator: "Go charge up, Adis. I've got your back."

- Valdur: "'Xenoflora'. Flowers. The only real alien life we've ever found, and the Sents scarf them down like kubrow chow! Just as well for us they did, eh, Tenno? Suddenly they've all got minds of their own, so no more hivemind, so no more war."
- Valdur: "Take out that gun, Tenno. We're getting pounded!"
- Anarch Galastra: "Tantivy, ha! What say you all? Shall we enlighten this Tenno?"
- Valdur: "Good work. This treaty's going to live, Galastra, and you don't get to tear it up. Dropships inbound!"
- Anarch Galastra: "Valdur. My old pet. Better count your flock again, dog, and keep your ships on the ground. Else I'll be set to carving your lost lamb."
- Anarch Galastra: "No history taught in those Tenno schools? Peace cannot abide the machines."
- Operator: "You're the only ones keeping this war alive."
- Anarch Galastra: "Let me show you why."
- Adis: "But... the blooms make us more than machine! Why does she hate?"
Anarch Galastra: "The promise of a home. So lightly surrendered."
- Note: this dialogue only occurs when observing a dead Summulyst with an orange hologram
- Anarch Galastra: "Of course! When he's good and ready, child. Sentient TQ-776VL! Repel intruders! So desperate for orders without your xenoflora."
- Adis: "Hive-kin, Adis will heal!" (singing) "Cast and cry, cast and cry" ｜ "Raise the million pylons high" ｜ "All our kin are bound to fly" ｜ "For that far shore forlorn"
- Operator: "I'm sorry! I didn't want to! It was him or me... him or me!"
- The Man in the Wall: "IVBOK AIO-UN KARIS, MARA LOHK!"
- Lotus: "Tenno! The truth of Tau must not be taken from us again. I need you to go back under, however briefly. If the danger becomes too great, in your mind or in this place, you will sense it."
- Archimedean Itzam: "And so you returned without Adis? Most unfortunate. Your, ah, patron has asked me to inquire about... the voices?"
- Archimedean Itzam: "Let us hope so. Now. What would you say is Galastra's goal?"
She's trying to restart the war by turning Sentients hostile.
- Operator: "War. Using the Sentients as her tools."
- Archimedean Itzam: "A sound hypothesis. We know she can undo the liberating effect of the blooms."
She wants Tau for herself and her followers.
- Operator: "Tau. All of it. Just for her and her people."
- Archimedean Itzam: "To be promised land as a reward for fighting, only to see it given to the enemy... It must be bitter indeed."
- Operator: "There are still too many unknown factors."
- Archimedean Itzam: "Ah. the lament of the true Archimedean. 'Insufficient data'."
- Archimedean Itzam: "Your somatic readout indicates emotional stress. I am not judging you for what happened, Tenno. But we must find Adis."

- Daklo: "Tenno, I know you're loyal and you want this to work, but you know it as well as I do: there is something deeply amiss with the Sentients. If they're so proud of who they are, then why do they want to be human so badly? And every time they try, it's just off, isn't it? Just know you have a friend in me if you ever need to talk."
- Adis: "Let's not lose the We also."
- Operator: "Never. So, uh... do you wanna go hunting? With me?"
- Assignator Korffel: "Hold up, Tenno. We just intercepted an Anarch transmission. Listen to this."
- Anarch Galastra: "...confirming debris field. The prey has gone to ground, my hunters. Tantivy!"
- Operator: "Adis, get on comms. We need intel. I'm going after them."
- Adis: "Tenno, go after ones with big shiny hat!"
- Adis: "Lus-tra-tus? They lead. They know orders from Galastra. Make them tell!"
- Anarch Capsarii: "Loffler berries? Waste of good soil. Vineyards for me."
- Anarch Libritor: "Tenno scorch the earth, none of us get nothing."
- Anarch Capsarii: "You know it's all done with drones and gas, right? Tenno don't exist."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "A shuttle... she has it shot down... the Makvos..."
- Adis: "Dax cannot defy Kuva. But Anarchs defy Orokin? How?"
- Operator: "Orokin houses clash all the time. Dax can kill troops, they just can't hurt the Golden Lords themselves."
- Adis: "Maybe through hive-kin... they try to find a way?"
- The Man in the Wall: "Slice. Burn. Maim. We love it when you get to cut loose."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "The xenoflora... without them, they revert to... to..."
- Adis: "With the blooms, Tau made us free. All know this."
- Operator: "But what happens if you don't get them?"
- Adis: "Hunger. For orders. If none come... hivemind would return."
- Operator: "Gonna scramble this targeting array, Adis. That ought to bring a Lustratus out of hiding."
- Operator: "The downed shuttle. Where is it?"
- Operator: "Galastra shot down a shuttle. She's got to be after the passengers."
- Assignator Korffel: "If we can't keep the peace then this treaty's dead in the water. Get back down there, Tenno!"
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "New orders incoming from Galastra. Stand by."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "Tenno target is identified. Transmitting coordinates. Tantivy!"
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "Distribution of rations has once again been delayed."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "Burying parties are permitted to sell their armor and weapons."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "All free Dax are entitled to a land claim. Speak to your commanding officer."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "It is imperative that all free Dax nominate a beneficiary."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "Correspondence delivered after the dated deadline will not be accepted."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "We did not betray the Orokin. The Orokin betrayed us."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "Honor can never be taken from you."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "Those who can no longer fight may serve with honor as Yaskutai, or accept the Bitter Tea."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "Cool water flows, the moon behind a cloud. To the receptive mind, all things come in time."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "Sun at mid-heaven, sovereign above all. Mind in firm action commits without reflecting."
- Operator: "This was a VIP transport. Whoever Galastra's hunting, they're Orokin."
- Palanquin: "Attention! Dignitary aboard! Atten... Identify yourself."
- Operator: "Tauron student, first class division M four dash A. By the glory and wisdom of the Seven I salute you."
- Adis: "Void cloak emittings. Hidden Dax close. Careful, Tenno!"
- Palanquin: "Your service is acknowledged. Escort the Executor to the extraction point."
- Palanquin: "Dispatch these barbarians before they reave us apart!"
- Palanquin: "Another such assault and we are finished."
- Palanquin: "This vehicle is hanging on by the rivets!"
- Palanquin: "We are in tatters. How could you neglect your duty so?"
- Palanquin: "If our passenger dies, the responsibility will be on your addled head."
- Palanquin: "Be aware that I am authorized to perform emergency Continuity to save Orokin lives, and you are the only potential Yuvan in the vicinity."
- Palanquin: "We cannot move faster without endangering our passenger."
- Palanquin: "We will not go one step further without your protection."
- Palanquin: "How can you defend us from over there?"
- Palanquin: "Hasten to our site if you please!"
- Anarch Galastra: "... He'll come around, or he'll serve as an example..."
- Operator: "Keep monitoring, Adis. We need to know more."
- Palanquin: "Ugh, a barricade. How crude. Remove it."
- Palanquin: "The terrain is treacherous. We must exercise caution. Be patient."
- Operator: "Adis... did... did your people do this?"
- Adis: "A devil-frame who did devil's work! He deserve this, Ten-no."

- Anarch Galastra: "... spill an Executor's guts with everyone watching, and not go to war on the spot? No. I know how the Orokin think. Once they see a Sentient disembowel an Executor, the treaty is as good as dead..."
- Anarch Galastra: "Little Tenno. You are way out of your depth. Now the big fish are going to devour you. Sentient PV-22! Destroy the medical transport and kill the passenger!"
- Loid: "I'm afraid the Murmur are coming. In numbers. Only a few automated defenses left between us and them. I'm trying to contact the Cavia, but..."
- Loid: "Tenno. See reason! If the Indifference encroaches upon the equipment here, it could trap your mind and leave your body an empty husk!"
- Operator: "Seal the doors, Loid. I have to go deeper."
- Archimedean Itzam: "With the Seven split, Ballas held the casting vote. Peace is entirely in his hands, and the warmongers whisper in his ear day and night. Your presence may offend him."
- Archimedean Itzam: "Orokin gratitude is like summer lightning: its light is fleeting merely, and wrath soon follows. Wait outside. I shall do what I can."
- Ballas: "Wise Itzam. First of the Sentient Archimedeans. Speak."

- Archimedean Itzam: "It's Galastra, Executor. Her Anarchs now occupy every one of the known world-seeders. Many of our bloom nurseries lie in ashes! Tokh-Amn itself is threatened! We believe she may be receiving assistance. Executor Nitokh is helping.

- Ballas: "The moon Perita is soon to be sovereign Sentient territory, per article 92. 'All Orokin forces to withdraw.' Remain and we violate the treaty, depart and we abandon a friend in need! What, then, would you have me do about Galastra?"
- Archimedean Itzam: "I have spoken to my fellow Archimedean. Your... consort? It appears the world-seeders have a weakness."
- Assignator Korffel: "Shake a leg. Adis and Itzam are waiting for you at Tokh-Amn."
- Assignator Korffel: "Remember, this place is holy to them. So mind your manners."
- Operator: "You were born here? It's beautiful."
- Bloom Guardian Amar: "Amn-tavosh! Ma veren tokh-amn eet! Ma zid ik aran. Bar dakh."

- Archimedean Itzam: "When I told Executor Ballas of the peril Tokh-Amn was facing, I little thought he would place me in charge of its defense. In this sacred place, the minds that had begun to grow on our long journey finally flowered. Tenno, Adis, in the spirit of Tokh-Amn I bind your souls together. Be the example we look to, the living truth of peace. The two of you have already been tested deeply, beyond any grade or metric. I have nothing left to teach. I deem you both Tauron Adept. May your union never be sundered."
- Archimedean Itzam: "A graduation present from the lady herself."
- Bloom Guardian Amar: "Bar-lorun! Mo heekra! (Defend here! I warn the others!)"
- Operator: "Valdur? Come in, damn it! You've got a rogue battalion down here!"
- Valdur: "Negative, Tenno. Those traitors were grown off-site."
Valdur: "A rogue Executor and her lapdog. We need to get Itzam out of there now. I'm sending a shuttle. You clear a landing zone!"
- Loid: (background) "No way to tell without joining them, wherever they are."
- Valdur: "Shuttle inbound. It's taken some hits. Just make sure it sets down in one piece."

- Archimedean Itzam: "Thank you, Tenno. You two have been a singular headache at times, but I admit I shall miss our classes. Perhaps you might consider returning next year, to speak to the new students."
- The Man in the Wall: "Just can't keep them alive, can you, kiddo? Everyone who cares for you ends up dead."

- Margulis: "Galastra tried to steal the life of my love. For that alone she deserves death. But the complete extinction of the Tau blooms, which she plans to bring about, would hurl us back into a state of war. With the collusion of Executor Nitokh and her lackey Roathe, she has sequestered herself and her followers within the world-seeders, the armored Zariman Ova of old. But they have a flaw. A destruct sequence. This Ayatan holds the trigger codes. Deliver it to the world-seeder's heart and turn Galastra's fortress into her funeral pyre."
- Assignator Korffel: "Give 'em hell for me, kid."
- Ballas: "Your people faced extinction, you found wisdom, and now you rise. Peace is trembling in our hands. Let us boldly grasp it."
- Dax Anarch Lustratus: "Void knows how, but they've found us!"
- Anarch Galastra: "You think... you are the only ones... to command the Frames?"
- Adis: "Control frames, but no Tenno? Galastra burn herself up for sure."
- Anarch Galastra: "Play the wolf, Tenno. Cut down the suckling lamb and join the side that's going to win."
- Anarch Galastra: "Peace isn't won with flowers and songs! You only get peace... through sacrifice!"
- Anarch Galastra: "I'm going to die on my estate, here on my moon, surrounded by weeping grandchildren and howling Kubrows. Not now. And not by your hand!"
- Operator: "It's... me. I can't do this. I don't want to do this!"
- Operator: "Loid. What. No. You can't be here on Tau."
- Loid: "You're not on Tau. This is a memory. It happened. And I'm so sorry, but we can't change any of it."
- Operator: "But we're almost at the part where..."
- Adis: "It's okay. I'm here. My light goes with you. Always."
- Loid: "I can't! They've gone too deep!"
- Loid: "Murmur. Breaking the perimeter seals. Flooding the labs. It's over."

- Loid: "Tenno, I must ask you to pace yourself! Nobody doubts your strength, but the Dark Refractory places a murderous burden on the user. If you persist in your current state, there is a real risk that we will lose you!"
- Loid: "I've not seen this kind of Murmur activity since the day my Albrecht left us. It's like... religious hysteria."
- Loid: "Only a few remain, Tenno. Deal with them and then rest."
- Operator: "Prep the machine, Loid. I have to go back."
- Loid: "This will be your last trip. If the process is not completed this time, you will never come back up."
- Ballas: "In the name of the Seven, the Lady Margulis and I welcome the delegates of the Sentient Collective. How brightly Perintol's odd little star shines now."
- Anarch Galastra: "Tell me, Tenno-brat. Why do you still serve the Orokin? Do you really trust them to keep their word?"
- Anarch Galastra: "It's not too late to see the light, Tenno. Even for you."
- Anarch Galastra: "The blind... lead the blind... and it all ends... in chaos."
- Anarch Galastra: "Good. Your final evolution. Kill me."
- Adis: "Why would Adis ever want to be like you?"
- Adis: "How many Golden curse-pods, Tenno? Enough for whole world? For whole SYSTEM?"
- Operator: "Ballas and the others. They used us. Set us up."
- Adis: "Voko ra'haal. Margulis dies for this."
- Adis: "Always you know where to find me, Ten-no."
- Apex Stentor: "Attention. Following the many treacherous Sentient attacks on loyal Grineer and Dax allies, the treaty is null and void. Orokin protection is hereby withdrawn. We are at war."
- Operator: "Adis, you've got to stop! This is what they wanted!"
- Apex Stentor: "Attention. A rogue Tenno operative and Sentient cohort are suspected of sabotage. They are to be brought in alive or dead."
- Operator: "Margulis couldn't have done this! Think, Adis! This is a setup!"
- Adis: "M'aran tegu LOKSH! You are blind as she!"
- Operator: "They're coming to kill us both! Don't you see? They'll cover it up! They always do!"
- Adis: "Tenno... you were right. I... am sorry-"
- Operator: "Shh. It's okay. It's okay. We're together."
- Adis: "(singing) "Cast and cry, cast and cry" ｜ "Raise the million pylons high" ｜ "All our kin are bound to fly" ｜ "For that far shore forlorn"
- Kill Squad Leader: "Target ahead. Taking them out."
- Adis: "My light goes with you now."
- Valdur: "Yes. I was... I was meant to make sure. But I couldn't, Tenno."
- Valdur: "I'm meant to take him back to Tauron Academy -"
- The Man in the Wall: "They're laughing at you up there, kiddo."
- Operator: "You changed the codes! Didn't you?"
- Operator: "Coward! Come out and face me!"
- Operator: "I should've let Galastra tear you apart!"
- Daklo: "Tenno? Dear Void... I saw it all!"
- Daklo: "The Grineer were prepared. They knew. The moment Ballas announced the treaty was dead, they opened fire!
- Daklo: "Yes. Yes, of course. Thank you."
- Operator: "A change of heart? From a bigot like you? I don't buy it."
- Operator: "Burn with the rest of them."
- Operator: "Rap, tap, tap! You'll let me in, little piggy!"
- Operator: "Tell me you had nothing to do with it!"
- Margulis: "You had a very hard day, my angel, and we have a long journey back to Lua. The Dream will keep the voices from taking hold."
- Operator: "You're going to make me forget."
- Margulis: "I will not have them accuse you of treason. If they come for you, they will have to go through me."
- Operator: "But Ballas... if he did this... he'll kill y-you..."
- Lotus: "You were used. Just as she was."
- Margulis: "We can finally begin to heal."
- Lotus: "Tau is in sight. It will not be the place that you or I remember."
> “A long-forgotten promise is remembered. The truth of Tau is laid bare, even as the mocking whispers of the Indifference grow louder. Soon the final leap may at last be taken.”
> “To access The Descendia and The Perita Rebellion use the Dark Refractory option at the Navigation Console in your Base of Operations.”
> Like you, I mourn for the peace that might have been. But we cannot make the past our prison. We look backward, only to learn where we are going.
> Adis Truth-Bloom possessed a power unique/rare among Sentients: the power to heal our kind. If another like him exists, we must find them.
> Loid has granted us full use of the Dark Refractory. Use it. Your chaotic memories of Tau must be entered, tamed, and understood.
> Your memories of the Warframe Uriel have enabled Loid to reconstruct his blueprint. A difficult task, as the Orokin attempted to destroy all copies. Use Uriel with caution, if you use him at all.”
(Attachments: Uriel Blueprint, Operator Atmosphor, 75 X Lyroic Bridge, 75 X Ren Hypercore, 75 X Ascaris Prime)
> During your battles on Tau, you were never truly alone. These Tenno fought by your side:
> Place this memorial in your base of operations so that you will always remember their names.” —Lotus

POM2_LAB1: Drifter. Forgive me for the impropriety of this imposition, I did not wish to contact you using this device. But this is verging on an emergency and I did not know to whom else I could turn.
- POM2_LAB1: Ah, yes. This is still on default settings. This is Loid. I should have... led with that, but matters here in the Sanctum Anatomica have been deeply chaotic of late.
- POM2_LAB1: Which is why I am contacting you. I am in need of your assistance. Three protoframes have arrived here, in the Sanctum, in my time. And not ones previously known to us.
- POM2_LAB1: One of them is an
POM2_LAB1: One of them is Orokin, Drifter.

- POM2_LAB1: The Lotus and the Operator have other matters to attend to, believe me. They have been taxed well and truly enough to their limits as it is. I would not ask you to help me with these matters if I felt I had anywhere else to turn.
- POM2_LAB1: I would not ask you to help me with these matters if I felt I had anywhere else to turn.
- POM2_LAB1: I would not ask you to help me with these matters if I felt I had anywhere else to turn.
- POM2_LAB1: You are... seemingly the new expert in matters of this kind.

- POM2_LAB1: I do not know how to best describe them. But if you come to the Sanctum, I believe it will be hard to miss them. Two of them have agreed to speak to you here on the POM-2. One may need some further convincing.
- POM2_LAB1: I have... faith... you will be successful.
- Lyon: "He spoke in truths. A devil has come."
- Marie: "Sol and Lua, we will cleanse this follower."
- Valdur: "With respect, sir, we need urgent Warframe support, or you will have a massacre on your hands and a dead treaty."
- Valdur: "Good work. All crews, prepare to launch."
- Anarch Galastra: "You can't "heal" a core override, child. This only ends one way."
- Valdur: "Adis can't heal a core override, and I can't patch up a dead treaty! This has to end here. That's an order."
- Operator: "Yes. I mean... I don't want it to change."
- Archimedean Itzam: "Tested in truth. You pass. I deem you both Tauron Adept. May your union never be sundered."
- Valdur: "Shuttle has locked on. Entering lower atmosphere. Not long now."

- Valdur: "You might not think so, but you two did a damn good job. While you were keeping Galastra busy, Ballas and the bigwigs up here have been hard at work. They're signing the treaty in just under an hour. Itzam couldn't have had a better memorial than that."
- Anarch Galastra: "Play the wolf, Tenno. Cut down the suckling lamb and join the side that's going to win."
